recipe.name: Aloo Matar
steps: Peel and cut potatoes into 2 cm cubes; finely chop onion, tomatoes, ginger, garlic and chilli.
Heat oil, bloom cumin, then fry onion for 7–8 minutes until golden. Add ginger, garlic and chilli; cook 1 minute.
Add tomatoes, turmeric, coriander, chilli powder and salt. Cook 8–10 minutes until thick and the oil begins to separate.
Stir in potatoes, peas and water. Cover and simmer 15–18 minutes until potatoes are tender; finish with garam masala and coriander.
tips: Add a splash of hot water if the gravy reduces before the potatoes cook.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Sarson ka Saag
steps: Wash all greens thoroughly, discard tough stalks and chop leaves. Put them in a covered pot with water, half the ginger, chillies and salt.
Simmer the greens 35–40 minutes until very soft; mash coarsely with a whisk or pulse briefly, keeping some texture.
Mix maize flour with a little cooking liquid to form a smooth slurry. Stir into the saag and simmer uncovered 15 minutes, stirring to prevent sticking.
Heat ghee separately; fry onion, remaining ginger and garlic until golden. Fold into the thick saag and simmer 5 minutes before serving.
tips: Serve hot with makki roti; bathua can be replaced with extra spinach if unavailable.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Lauki ki Sabzi
steps: Peel lauki, remove mature seeds if present and cut into 2 cm cubes; chop onion, tomato, ginger and chilli.
Heat oil and let cumin crackle. Fry onion 5 minutes; add ginger and chilli and stir for 1 minute.
Add tomato, turmeric, coriander and salt; cook 5–6 minutes until tomato softens and thickens.
Fold in lauki and water. Cover and cook 15–18 minutes, stirring once, until tender but still holding its shape. Garnish with coriander.
tips: Young lauki releases water as it cooks; add extra water only if the pan dries out.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Bharwa Bhindi
steps: Wash okra well and dry completely. Trim only the stems, then slit each pod lengthwise without cutting through.
Dry-roast gram flour 3–4 minutes until nutty. Cool and mix with coriander, fennel, amchur, chilli, turmeric, salt and 20 ml oil.
Fill every slit with the spice mixture, pressing gently so the filling stays inside.
Heat remaining oil in a wide pan. Arrange okra in one layer, cover and cook on low heat 12 minutes; turn carefully and cook uncovered another 8–10 minutes until tender and lightly crisp.
tips: Do not add water; dry okra and a wide pan prevent sliminess.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Aloo Methi
steps: Pick fenugreek leaves off thick stems, wash repeatedly and drain well; peel potatoes and cut into 1.5 cm cubes.
Heat oil and crackle cumin. Fry chopped onion 5 minutes, then add garlic and chilli for 1 minute.
Add potatoes, turmeric and half the salt. Cover and cook on low heat 12–15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until nearly tender.
Add fenugreek, chilli powder and remaining salt. Cook uncovered 7–8 minutes until leaves wilt and moisture evaporates; finish with lemon.
tips: Salt fenugreek near the end so the sabzi stays fairly dry.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Gobi Matar
steps: Cut cauliflower into even florets and wash. Chop onion and tomatoes; mince ginger and garlic.
Heat oil; bloom cumin and brown onion for 6 minutes. Add ginger and garlic for 1 minute.
Add tomatoes, turmeric, coriander, chilli powder and salt; fry 6–8 minutes until tomato breaks down.
Fold in cauliflower and peas with water. Cover and cook 12–15 minutes until just tender; uncover to dry excess liquid, then add garam masala and coriander.
tips: Keep cauliflower pieces firm rather than cooking them until mushy.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Bharwan Karela
steps: Scrape bitter gourds lightly, slit lengthwise and remove mature seeds. Rub with 8 g salt and leave 20 minutes; squeeze and rinse, then pat dry.
Dry-roast gram flour 3 minutes. In 15 ml oil, fry finely chopped onion until golden; mix with flour, fennel, coriander, amchur, turmeric, chilli and remaining salt.
Pack the onion-spice filling into the gourds and close each slit with a toothpick if needed.
Heat remaining oil in a broad pan; lay the gourds in one layer. Cover and cook on low heat 20 minutes, turning gently, then uncover and brown 8–10 minutes until tender.
tips: Taste a tiny piece before serving; larger gourds may need 5 more minutes.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Tinda Masala
steps: Peel tinda thinly and quarter; remove hard seeds only if mature. Finely chop onion and tomato.
Heat oil and crackle cumin; cook onion 6 minutes until golden. Add ginger and garlic for 1 more minute.
Stir in tomato, turmeric, coriander, chilli and salt; fry 7 minutes until the masala thickens.
Add tinda and water, cover and simmer 15–18 minutes until a knife slides in easily. Uncover to thicken, then stir in garam masala.
tips: Choose small, firm tinda with tender seeds for the best texture.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Aloo Baingan
steps: Cut eggplant into 3 cm pieces and keep in water briefly. Peel and cube potatoes smaller, about 2 cm, so both finish together.
Heat oil and cumin. Fry onion 6 minutes; add ginger and tomatoes, then turmeric, coriander, chilli and salt. Cook 7 minutes until thick.
Add potatoes and water; cover for 8 minutes. Drain eggplant and fold in gently so it gets coated in the masala.
Cover and simmer another 12–15 minutes, turning gently, until potato is tender and eggplant silky. Uncover to reduce excess liquid; finish with coriander.
tips: Stir gently once eggplant goes in so the pieces do not collapse.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

gu.Quantities serve four adults. Check the: માત્રા ચાર પુખ્ત વ્યક્તિઓ માટે છે. દરેક પગલામાં પાકવાના સંકેત તપાસો અને સ્વાદ પ્રમાણે મસાલો ગોઠવો. જૈન યોગ્યતા તમારા પરિવારના સામગ્રીના નિયમો પર આધારિત છે.
gu.Cut eggplant into 3 cm pieces and keep i: રીંગણના 3 સેમીના ટુકડા કરી થોડું પાણીમાં રાખો. બટાકા છોલી નાનાં 2 સેમીના ટુકડા કરો જેથી બંને સાથે પાકે.
gu.Heat oil and cumin. Fry onion 6 minutes;: તેલમાં જીરું તતડાવો. ડુંગળી 6 મિનિટ શેકો; આદુ અને ટામેટાં, પછી હળદર, ધાણા, મરચું અને મીઠું નાખો. 7 મિનિટ ઘટ્ટ કરો.
gu.Add potatoes and water; cover for 8 minu: બટાકા અને પાણી ઉમેરી 8 મિનિટ ઢાંકો. રીંગણ નીતારી હળવેથી મસાલામાં ભેળવો.
gu.Cover and simmer another 12–15 minutes,: ઢાંકીને 12–15 મિનિટ વધુ હળવેથી ફેરવી પકાવો, બટાકા નરમ અને રીંગણ રેશમી થાય ત્યાં સુધી. વધારાનું પાણી સુકવી ધાણા નાખો.
gu.Stir gently once eggplant goes in so the: રીંગણ નાખ્યા પછી હળવેથી હલાવો જેથી ટુકડા ભાંગી ન જાય.

recipe.name: Kathal ki Sabzi
steps: Oil your knife, cut cleaned young jackfruit into 3 cm pieces and rinse away the sticky sap. Simmer in lightly salted water 15 minutes; drain.
Heat oil and cumin; fry onion 8 minutes until brown at the edges. Add ginger and garlic; cook 1 minute.
Add tomato, turmeric, coriander, chilli and salt; cook 8 minutes until thick. Lower heat and stir in whisked yogurt gradually so it does not split.
Add jackfruit and water; cover and simmer 20–25 minutes until fork-tender and coated in gravy. Stir in garam masala and fresh coriander.
tips: Use unripe green jackfruit, not sweet ripe jackfruit; drain canned young jackfruit before cooking.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

hi.Quantities serve four adults. Check the: मात्राएँ चार वयस्कों के लिए हैं। हर चरण में पकने के संकेत जाँचें और स्वाद के अनुसार मसाला बदलें। जैन उपयुक्तता आपके परिवार की सामग्री संबंधी नियमों पर निर्भर है।
hi.Oil your knife, cut cleaned young jackfr: चाकू पर तेल लगाकर साफ कच्चा कटहल 3 सेमी टुकड़ों में काटें और चिपचिपा रस धोएँ। हल्के नमकीन पानी में 15 मिनट उबालकर छानें।
hi.Heat oil and cumin; fry onion 8 minutes: तेल में जीरा चटकाकर प्याज़ 8 मिनट किनारे भूरे होने तक भूनें। अदरक और लहसुन डालकर 1 मिनट पकाएँ।
hi.Add tomato, turmeric, coriander, chilli: टमाटर, हल्दी, धनिया, मिर्च और नमक डालकर 8 मिनट गाढ़ा करें। आँच कम कर फेंटा दही थोड़ा-थोड़ा मिलाएँ ताकि फटे नहीं।
hi.Add jackfruit and water; cover and simme: कटहल और पानी डालकर ढकें; 20–25 मिनट काँटा आसानी से लगे और ग्रेवी चढ़े तब तक पकाएँ। गरम मसाला और हरा धनिया मिलाएँ।
hi.Use unripe green jackfruit, not sweet ri: मीठे पके कटहल की जगह कच्चा हरा कटहल लें; डिब्बाबंद कच्चा कटहल इस्तेमाल करें तो पहले छानें।

gu.Quantities serve four adults. Check the: માત્રા ચાર પુખ્ત વ્યક્તિઓ માટે છે. દરેક પગલામાં પાકવાના સંકેત તપાસો અને સ્વાદ પ્રમાણે મસાલો ગોઠવો. જૈન યોગ્યતા તમારા પરિવારના સામગ્રીના નિયમો પર આધારિત છે.
gu.Oil your knife, cut cleaned young jackfr: છરીને તેલ લગાવી સાફ કાચાં ફણસના 3 સેમીના ટુકડા કરો અને ચીકણો રસ ધુઓ. હળવા મીઠાવાળા પાણીમાં 15 મિનિટ ઉકાળી નીતારો.
gu.Heat oil and cumin; fry onion 8 minutes: તેલમાં જીરું તતડાવી ડુંગળી 8 મિનિટ કિનારી ભૂરા થાય ત્યાં સુધી શેકો. આદુ અને લસણ ઉમેરી 1 મિનિટ પકાવો.
gu.Add tomato, turmeric, coriander, chilli: ટામેટાં, હળદર, ધાણા, મરચું અને મીઠું ઉમેરી 8 મિનિટ ઘટ્ટ કરો. તાપ ઓછો કરી ફેંટેલું દહીં થોડું થોડું ઉમેરો જેથી ફાટે નહીં.
gu.Add jackfruit and water; cover and simme: ફણસ અને પાણી ઉમેરી ઢાંકો; 20–25 મિનિટ કાંટો સહેલાઈથી ઘૂસે અને રસો ચડે ત્યાં સુધી પકાવો. ગરમ મસાલો અને લીલા ધાણા ભેળવો.
gu.Use unripe green jackfruit, not sweet ri: મીઠાં પાકાં ફણસને બદલે કાચું લીલું ફણસ લો; ડબ્બાબંધ કાચું ફણસ વાપરો તો પહેલાં નીતારો.

recipe.name: Majjige Huli
steps: Soak chana dal 30 minutes. Peel, deseed and cube ash gourd; cook in 200 ml water with turmeric and salt for 12–15 minutes until just tender.
Grind drained dal with coconut, chillies, ginger, cumin and remaining water to a smooth paste. Whisk yogurt separately until smooth.
Stir the paste into the cooked gourd and simmer 5 minutes. Turn heat very low, add yogurt and warm gently without boiling so it stays smooth.
Heat oil in a small pan; crackle mustard, asafoetida and curry leaves. Pour the hot tempering over the huli and serve with rice.
tips: Never boil the curry after adding yogurt.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

hi.Quantities serve four adults. Check the: मात्राएँ चार वयस्कों के लिए हैं। हर चरण में पकने के संकेत जाँचें और स्वाद के अनुसार मसाला बदलें। जैन उपयुक्तता आपके परिवार की सामग्री संबंधी नियमों पर निर्भर है।
hi.Soak chana dal 30 minutes. Peel, deseed: चना दाल 30 मिनट भिगोएँ। पेठा छीलकर बीज हटाएँ और टुकड़े करें; 200 मि.ली. पानी, हल्दी और नमक में 12–15 मिनट नरम होने तक पकाएँ।
hi.Grind drained dal with coconut, chillies: भीगी दाल छानकर नारियल, मिर्च, अदरक, जीरा और बचा पानी मिलाकर चिकना पीसें। दही अलग फेंटें।
hi.Stir the paste into the cooked gourd and: पका पेठा में पिसा मसाला मिलाकर 5 मिनट पकाएँ। आँच बहुत कम कर दही डालें और उबाल आए बिना गरम करें ताकि फटे नहीं।
hi.Heat oil in a small pan; crackle mustard: छोटी कड़ाही में तेल गरम कर राई, हींग और कड़ी पत्ता चटकाएँ। तड़का हुली पर डालकर चावल के साथ परोसें।
hi.Never boil the curry after adding yogurt: दही डालने के बाद करी को न उबालें।

gu.Quantities serve four adults. Check the: માત્રા ચાર પુખ્ત વ્યક્તિઓ માટે છે. દરેક પગલામાં પાકવાના સંકેત તપાસો અને સ્વાદ પ્રમાણે મસાલો ગોઠવો. જૈન યોગ્યતા તમારા પરિવારના સામગ્રીના નિયમો પર આધારિત છે.
gu.Soak chana dal 30 minutes. Peel, deseed: ચણા દાળ 30 મિનિટ પલાળો. કોળું છોલી બી કાઢી ટુકડા કરો; 200 મિ.લી. પાણી, હળદર અને મીઠામાં 12–15 મિનિટ નરમ થાય ત્યાં સુધી પકાવો.
gu.Grind drained dal with coconut, chillies: પલાળેલી દાળ નીતારી નાળિયેર, મરચાં, આદુ, જીરું અને બાકી પાણી સાથે લીસું પીસો. દહીં અલગ ફેંટો.
gu.Stir the paste into the cooked gourd and: પાકેલા કોળામાં પીસેલો મસાલો ઉમેરી 5 મિનિટ પકાવો. તાપ ખૂબ ઓછો કરી દહીં ઉમેરી ઉકાળો આવ્યા વિના ગરમ કરો જેથી ફાટે નહીં.
gu.Heat oil in a small pan; crackle mustard: નાની વઘારિયામાં તેલ ગરમ કરી રાઈ, હિંગ અને મીઠા લીમડાનાં પાન તતડાવો. વઘાર હુળીમાં નાખી ભાત સાથે પીરસો.
gu.Never boil the curry after adding yogurt: દહીં ઉમેર્યા પછી કઢીને ઉકાળશો નહીં.

recipe.name: Pulissery
steps: Cut mango into large pieces and simmer with turmeric, half the water and salt for 8–10 minutes until tender.
Grind coconut, green chillies and cumin with remaining water into a fine paste; whisk yogurt smooth.
Add coconut paste to mango and simmer 4 minutes. Reduce heat and stir in yogurt; warm gently for 2–3 minutes without boiling.
Heat coconut oil and crackle mustard seeds, dried red chillies and curry leaves. Pour over the curry and rest 5 minutes before serving.
tips: Use sweet ripe mango to balance the lightly sour yogurt; do not let yogurt boil.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

gu.Grind coconut, green chillies and cumin: નાળિયેર, લીલાં મરચાં અને જીરું બાકી પાણી સાથે બારીક પીસો; દહીં લીસું ફેંટો.
gu.Add coconut paste to mango and simmer 4: કેરીમાં નાળિયેરની પેસ્ટ ઉમેરી 4 મિનિટ પકાવો. તાપ ઓછો કરી દહીં ભેળવો; ઉકાળ્યા વિના 2–3 મિનિટ ગરમ કરો.

recipe.name: Kadala Curry
steps: Soak black chickpeas overnight, drain and pressure-cook with 600 ml water and half the salt until soft, about 25–30 minutes under pressure. Reserve the cooking liquid.
Toast coconut in a dry pan until deep golden, then grind with 100 ml water to a smooth paste.
Heat coconut oil, crackle mustard and curry leaves, then fry onion 7 minutes. Add ginger and garlic, followed by tomato, coriander, chilli, turmeric and remaining salt; cook until thick.
Add chickpeas, coconut paste and enough reserved liquid for a pourable curry. Simmer 12 minutes; finish with garam masala and serve with puttu or appam.
tips: Black chickpeas should crush easily between fingers before they enter the gravy.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

hi.Quantities serve four adults. Check the: मात्राएँ चार वयस्कों के लिए हैं। हर चरण में पकने के संकेत जाँचें और स्वाद के अनुसार मसाला बदलें। जैन उपयुक्तता आपके परिवार की सामग्री संबंधी नियमों पर निर्भर है।

hi.Heat coconut oil, crackle mustard and cu: नारियल तेल में राई और कड़ी पत्ता चटकाकर प्याज़ 7 मिनट भूनें। अदरक-लहसुन, फिर टमाटर, धनिया, मिर्च, हल्दी और बाकी नमक डालकर गाढ़ा पकाएँ।

recipe.name: Tomato Pappu
steps: Rinse toor dal until water runs clear. Put in a pressure cooker with 650 ml water, chopped tomatoes, onion, green chillies and turmeric; cook 3–4 whistles until soft.
Mash the cooked dal and tomatoes. Stir in tamarind, salt and remaining 200 ml water; simmer uncovered 8 minutes.
Heat oil in a small pan; crackle mustard and cumin. Add dried chillies, curry leaves and crushed garlic; fry until garlic turns pale golden.
Pour the hot tempering into the dal, cover 2 minutes to capture the aroma, then stir and serve with rice.
tips: Tomatoes give most of the tang; reduce tamarind if they are very sour.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Gongura Pappu
steps: Rinse toor dal and pressure-cook with 650 ml water and turmeric for 3–4 whistles until soft; mash coarsely.
Remove thick stalks from gongura, wash and chop leaves. Cook leaves and green chillies with remaining 150 ml water 7–8 minutes until wilted and sour aroma develops.
Mix gongura into dal with salt; simmer 8 minutes so the tang spreads through the dal.
Heat oil, crackle mustard and cumin, then fry dried chillies, curry leaves and crushed garlic until aromatic. Pour over the dal and serve with rice.
tips: Gongura is naturally sour, so taste before adding any extra acid.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Mamidikaya Pappu
steps: Peel raw mango, remove the stone and cube the flesh. Rinse dal and put it in a pressure cooker with mango, green chillies, turmeric and 650 ml water.
Cook for 3–4 whistles until dal is soft. Mash the dal and mango together, then add salt and remaining water and simmer 7 minutes.
Heat oil; splutter mustard and cumin. Add dried red chillies, curry leaves and crushed garlic; fry until garlic is golden.
Pour the tempering over pappu, stir and rest covered 3 minutes. Serve with hot rice and a little ghee if desired.
tips: Raw mango varies in acidity; taste the finished dal before adding more salt.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Muddha Pappu
steps: Rinse toor dal several times until the water is mostly clear; drain well.
Put dal, turmeric and water in a pressure cooker. Cook 3–4 whistles, then let the pressure fall naturally so the grains become completely soft.
Mash the dal thoroughly with a whisk into a thick, smooth mound; simmer uncovered 3–4 minutes if too loose.
Stir in salt and ghee just before serving. Spoon onto hot rice; mix at the table rather than making a runny dal.
tips: Muddha pappu is intentionally thick; serve with rice, ghee and pickle.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Pappu Charu
steps: Rinse dal and pressure-cook with turmeric and 600 ml water for 3–4 whistles until soft; mash well.
Simmer chopped tomatoes, onion, green chillies and chilli powder in 300 ml water for 8 minutes. Add tamarind pulp, jaggery and salt.
Add mashed dal and remaining 200 ml water. Simmer 10 minutes until the broth is pourable but still tastes of dal.
Crackle mustard and cumin in oil, add dried chillies and curry leaves, then pour the tempering over the charu. Serve hot with rice.
tips: Pappu charu is thinner than ordinary dal but fuller-bodied than rasam.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

hi.Pappu charu is thinner than ordinary dal: पप्पू चारू साधारण दाल से पतला, पर रसम से अधिक गाढ़ा होता है।

gu.Simmer chopped tomatoes, onion, green ch: સમારેલાં ટામેટાં, ડુંગળી, લીલાં મરચાં અને મરચું પાઉડર 300 મિ.લી. પાણીમાં 8 મિનિટ પકાવો. આમલી, ગોળ અને મીઠું ઉમેરો.

gu.Pappu charu is thinner than ordinary dal: પપ્પુ ચારુ સામાન્ય દાળ કરતાં પાતળું, પણ રસમ કરતાં વધુ ભરાવદાર હોય છે.

recipe.name: Ulavacharu
steps: Soak horse gram overnight. Drain, then pressure-cook in 1,300 ml fresh water with turmeric for 8–10 whistles until the beans are soft; reserve all the dark cooking liquid.
Strain the gram and mash or grind about 100 g of the cooked beans. Return this mash to the reserved broth; keep the rest of the beans for another meal.
Simmer chopped onion, tomato, tamarind, chilli powder, salt and remaining 200 ml water for 10 minutes. Add the horse-gram broth and reduce 15–20 minutes until richly flavoured.
Heat oil and crackle mustard and cumin; add crushed garlic and curry leaves until fragrant. Pour the tempering into the charu and serve hot with rice.
tips: Horse gram needs an overnight soak; the cooking liquid is the heart of this dish.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Dosakaya Pappu
steps: Taste a small piece of dosakaya and discard it if bitter. Peel, deseed and cube the rest; rinse dal.
Pressure-cook dal with cucumber, chopped tomato, green chillies, turmeric and 650 ml water for 3–4 whistles until soft.
Mash gently so some cucumber pieces remain. Add salt and remaining 150 ml water; simmer 7–8 minutes.
Heat oil, crackle mustard and cumin, then add dried chilli, crushed garlic and curry leaves. Pour over the dal and serve with rice.
tips: Use yellow dosakaya rather than a watery English cucumber for the intended tangy flavour.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

hi.Quantities serve four adults. Check the: मात्राएँ चार वयस्कों के लिए हैं। हर चरण में पकने के संकेत जाँचें और स्वाद के अनुसार मसाला बदलें। जैन उपयुक्तता आपके परिवार की सामग्री संबंधी नियमों पर निर्भर है।

recipe.name: Tomato Rice
steps: Rinse rice until the water clears and soak 20 minutes; drain. Chop tomatoes and onion finely.
Heat oil, crackle mustard and cumin; add curry leaves, onion, ginger and chillies. Fry 5–6 minutes until onion softens.
Add tomatoes, turmeric, chilli powder and salt. Cook 8 minutes until the tomato mixture is jammy and most moisture has evaporated.
Fold in drained rice and measured water. Bring to a boil, cover tightly and cook on low heat 13–15 minutes. Rest covered 10 minutes, fluff and add coriander.
tips: Ripe, slightly tart tomatoes give the rice its signature flavour.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

छने चावल और नापा पानी मिलाएँ। उबालें, कसकर ढकें और धीमी आँच पर 13–15 मिनट पकाएँ। 10 मिनट ढककर रखें, फुलाएँ और धनिया डालें।
hi.Ripe, slightly tart tomatoes give the ri: पके हल्के खट्टे टमाटर से चावल का असली स्वाद आता है।

gu.Heat oil, crackle mustard and cumin; add: તેલમાં રાઈ-જીરું તતડાવો; મીઠા લીમડાનાં પાન, ડુંગળી, આદુ અને મરચાં ઉમેરો. ડુંગળી નરમ થાય ત્યાં સુધી 5–6 મિનિટ શેકો.
gu.Add tomatoes, turmeric, chilli powder an: ટામેટાં, હળદર, મરચું પાઉડર અને મીઠું ઉમેરો. 8 મિનિટ મિશ્રણ ઘટ્ટ થાય અને મોટાભાગનું પાણી સુકાય ત્યાં સુધી પકાવો.
નીતારેલા ચોખા અને માપેલું પાણી ઉમેરો. ઉકાળો, સારી રીતે ઢાંકી ધીમી આંચે 13–15 મિનિટ પકાવો. 10 મિનિટ ઢાંકી રાખી હળવેથી ખોલો અને ધાણા ઉમેરો.
gu.Ripe, slightly tart tomatoes give the ri: પાકાં થોડાં ખાટાં ટામેટાંથી ભાતનો મૂળ સ્વાદ આવે છે.

recipe.name: Hyderabadi Veg Dum Biryani
steps: Rinse and soak rice 30 minutes. Fry sliced onions in oil until deep golden; remove half for layering. Whisk yogurt with ginger, garlic, chillies, biryani masala, half the salt and chopped herbs.
Mix vegetables into spiced yogurt and let stand 20 minutes. Meanwhile boil measured water with whole spices and remaining salt; cook drained rice 6–7 minutes until about 70% done, then drain.
Spread marinated vegetables and remaining fried onion in a heavy pot; layer par-cooked rice above. Sprinkle reserved onion, ghee and saffron soaked in warm milk over the top.
Seal the lid tightly, cook 5 minutes on medium-low then 20 minutes on very low heat over a tawa. Rest sealed 15 minutes; lift rice gently from the bottom and serve.
tips: The rice must be only partly cooked before dum or it will turn soft and sticky.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

hi.Rinse and soak rice 30 minutes. Fry slic: चावल धोकर 30 मिनट भिगोएँ। कटा प्याज़ तेल में गहरा सुनहरा तलें; आधा परत के लिए निकालें। दही में अदरक, लहसुन, मिर्च, बिरयानी मसाला, आधा नमक और कटे पत्ते फेंटें।
hi.Mix vegetables into spiced yogurt and le: सब्ज़ियाँ मसालेदार दही में मिलाकर 20 मिनट रखें। इस बीच नापे पानी में खड़े मसाले और बाकी नमक उबालें; छने चावल 6–7 मिनट लगभग 70% पकाकर छानें।
hi.Spread marinated vegetables and remainin: भारी बर्तन में दही वाली सब्ज़ियाँ और बचा भुना प्याज़ फैलाएँ; ऊपर अधपके चावल की परत दें। बचा प्याज़, घी और गुनगुने दूध में भीगा केसर छिड़कें।
hi.Seal the lid tightly, cook 5 minutes on: ढक्कन कसकर बंद करें; तवे पर मध्यम-धीमी आँच 5 मिनट, फिर बहुत धीमी आँच 20 मिनट पकाएँ। 15 मिनट बंद रखें; नीचे से हल्के से निकालकर परोसें।
hi.The rice must be only partly cooked befo: दम लगाने से पहले चावल अधपके रखें, नहीं तो वे नरम और चिपचिपे हो जाएँगे।

gu.Rinse and soak rice 30 minutes. Fry slic: ચોખા ધોઈ 30 મિનિટ પલાળો. સમારેલી ડુંગળી તેલમાં ઘેરી સોનેરી તળો; અડધી પડ માટે કાઢો. દહીંમાં આદુ, લસણ, મરચાં, બિરયાની મસાલો, અડધું મીઠું અને સમારેલી ભાજી ફેંટો.
gu.Mix vegetables into spiced yogurt and le: શાકભાજી મસાલેદાર દહીંમાં ભેળવી 20 મિનિટ રાખો. દરમ્યાન માપેલા પાણીમાં આખા મસાલા અને બાકી મીઠું ઉકાળો; નીતારેલા ચોખા 6–7 મિનિટ આશરે 70% રાંધી નીતારો.
gu.Spread marinated vegetables and remainin: જાડા તળિયાના વાસણમાં દહીંવાળાં શાક અને બાકી શેકેલી ડુંગળી પાથરો; ઉપર અધપાકા ચોખાનો પડ કરો. બાકી ડુંગળી, ઘી અને હૂંફાળા દૂધમાં પલાળેલું કેસર છાંટો.

gu.The rice must be only partly cooked befo: દમ પહેલાં ચોખા અધપાકા રાખો, નહીં તો નરમ અને ચીકણા થશે.

recipe.name: Kashmiri Pulao
steps: Rinse and soak rice 25 minutes, then drain. Soak saffron in warm milk and cut apple into small cubes just before use.
Heat half the ghee and toast almonds, cashews and raisins until nuts are light golden and raisins plump; remove.
In the remaining ghee, bloom whole spices for 30 seconds. Add drained rice, stir 2 minutes, then pour in water, salt and saffron milk. Cover and cook on low heat 13–15 minutes.
Rest rice covered 10 minutes and fluff gently. Fold in toasted nuts, raisins and apple; scatter pomegranate over the top immediately before serving.
tips: Add fresh fruit at the end so it stays bright and does not become mushy.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Tawa Pulao
steps: Break up clumps in cold cooked rice. Finely chop onion, tomato, capsicum and carrot; mince ginger and garlic.
Heat butter and oil on a wide tawa or pan. Fry onion 4 minutes, add ginger and garlic, then carrot and peas; cook 4 more minutes.
Add capsicum and tomato. Sprinkle pav bhaji masala, chilli powder and salt; fry 5–6 minutes until tomato becomes a thick coating.
Add rice in batches, tossing gently on high heat until every grain is coated and heated through. Finish with lemon and coriander.
tips: Use properly chilled rice; freshly cooked rice can break and clump on the tawa.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

hi.Break up clumps in cold cooked rice. Fin: ठंडे पके चावल के ढेले अलग करें। प्याज़, टमाटर, शिमला मिर्च और गाजर बारीक काटें; अदरक-लहसुन कूटें।
hi.Heat butter and oil on a wide tawa or pa: चौड़े तवे पर मक्खन और तेल गरम करें। प्याज़ 4 मिनट भूनें, अदरक-लहसुन डालें, फिर गाजर और मटर 4 मिनट पकाएँ।
hi.Add capsicum and tomato. Sprinkle pav bh: शिमला मिर्च और टमाटर डालें। पाव भाजी मसाला, मिर्च और नमक छिड़ककर 5–6 मिनट गाढ़ा मसाला बनने तक भूनें।
hi.Add rice in batches, tossing gently on h: चावल थोड़ा-थोड़ा डालकर तेज़ आँच पर हल्के पलटें, जब तक हर दाना मसाले से लिपटकर गरम हो। नींबू और धनिया डालें।
hi.Use properly chilled rice; freshly cooke: अच्छी तरह ठंडे चावल लें; ताज़े चावल तवे पर टूट और चिपक सकते हैं।

gu.Heat butter and oil on a wide tawa or pa: પહોળા તવા પર માખણ અને તેલ ગરમ કરો. ડુંગળી 4 મિનિટ શેકો, આદુ-લસણ ઉમેરો, પછી ગાજર અને વટાણા 4 મિનિટ પકાવો.
gu.Add capsicum and tomato. Sprinkle pav bh: શિમલા મરચાં અને ટામેટાં ઉમેરો. પાવભાજી મસાલો, મરચું અને મીઠું છાંટી 5–6 મિનિટ ઘટ્ટ મસાલો બને ત્યાં સુધી શેકો.

recipe.name: Vangi Bath
steps: Rinse and soak rice 20 minutes. Cook with 600 ml water until grains are separate, then spread out to cool. Cut eggplants into wedges and keep briefly in water.
Heat oil; fry peanuts and chana dal until golden. Add mustard and curry leaves, then sliced onion and cook 4 minutes.
Drain eggplant; add to pan with turmeric and salt. Cover 8–10 minutes until tender. Add vangi bath powder and tamarind; cook 2 minutes until spices coat the eggplant.
Fold the cooled rice into the spiced eggplant in batches. Warm 3–4 minutes on low heat, tossing gently so grains stay intact.
tips: Use a vangi bath spice blend, not ordinary garam masala; it gives the dish its distinctive flavour.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Ghee Rice
steps: Rinse rice until water clears, soak 20 minutes and drain thoroughly. Slice onion thinly.
Heat half the ghee and fry cashews and raisins until golden and plump; remove. Fry sliced onion in the same pan until deeply golden; remove half for garnish.
Add remaining ghee and whole spices to the pan; toast 30 seconds. Add drained rice and stir 2 minutes to coat each grain.
Pour in water and salt. Bring to a boil, cover tightly and cook on low heat 13–15 minutes. Rest 10 minutes, fluff and top with onion, cashews and raisins.
tips: Use good-quality ghee and let the rice rest covered so the grains stay long and separate.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Pudina Rice
steps: Rinse and soak rice 20 minutes. Blend mint, coriander, green chillies, ginger and 60 ml of the measured water to a smooth green paste.
Heat oil; bloom cumin and whole spices. Fry sliced onion 6 minutes, add peas and mint paste, and cook 4 minutes until raw aroma fades.
Add drained rice, remaining 540 ml water and salt. Bring to a boil, cover tightly and simmer on low heat 13–15 minutes until water is absorbed.
Rest covered 10 minutes, fluff gently and add lemon juice just before serving.
tips: Use mint leaves only, without the tough stalks, to avoid a bitter green paste.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Paneer Pulao
steps: Rinse and soak rice 20 minutes, then drain. Cut paneer into 2 cm cubes and pat dry; slice onion thinly.
Heat oil in a broad pan and sear paneer on two sides until lightly golden; remove before it toughens.
Add ghee, cumin and whole spices to the pan. Fry onion 6 minutes; add ginger, chilli and peas. Stir in drained rice and salt for 2 minutes.
Add measured water, cover and cook on low heat 13–15 minutes. Rest 10 minutes, then fold paneer and coriander through the rice gently.
tips: Add paneer after the rice rests so the cubes remain soft.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Kathal Biryani
steps: Oil a knife and cut cleaned young jackfruit into 3 cm pieces. Simmer in 400 ml of the measured water for 15 minutes until barely tender; drain. Rinse and soak rice 30 minutes.

Fry sliced onion in oil until deep golden; remove half. Add ginger, garlic, chilli and jackfruit to the pan; fry 5 minutes. Stir in yogurt, biryani masala, half the salt and half the herbs; cook until thick.

Boil remaining 1,300 ml water with whole spices and remaining salt. Cook soaked rice 6–7 minutes to 70% done and drain. Layer rice over jackfruit with fried onion, remaining herbs, ghee and saffron soaked in milk.
Seal the pot, cook on low heat over a tawa for 20–25 minutes and rest sealed 15 minutes. Lift gently from the bottom to preserve layers.
tips: Use young unripe jackfruit; ripe sweet jackfruit cannot replace it.

recipe.name: Mushroom Biryani
steps: Rinse and soak rice 25 minutes. Wipe mushrooms clean and quarter; slice onion, chop tomatoes, ginger and garlic.
Heat oil and ghee with whole spices. Fry onion until golden, then ginger, garlic and chillies for 1 minute; add tomatoes and biryani masala and cook until thick.
Add mushrooms and sauté on high heat 5 minutes to drive off moisture. Lower heat, fold in whisked yogurt, herbs and salt; cook 3 minutes.
Add drained rice and measured water. Bring to a boil, cover tightly and cook on very low heat 15 minutes. Rest covered 10 minutes before gently fluffing.
tips: Brown mushrooms first so the biryani stays fragrant instead of watery.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Pasta e Broccoli
steps: Cut broccoli into small florets and slice the tender stems. Bring measured water to a boil with salt in a wide pot.
Add broccoli and boil 4 minutes. Add short pasta to the same pot and cook according to its packet until just al dente, stirring often; broccoli should begin to soften into the cooking water.
Meanwhile warm olive oil with sliced garlic and chilli flakes in a small pan on low heat until garlic is pale golden, not brown.

Reserve 200 ml cooking water, then drain pasta and broccoli. Return them to the pot with garlic oil; toss vigorously, adding reserved water as needed for a silky broccoli sauce. Finish with grated vegetarian cheese.
tips: Use pasta with a similar cooking time to broccoli; the broccoli should partly melt into the sauce.

recipe.name: Pasta e Lenticchie

ingredients.name: egg-free small dry pasta or broken spaghetti

steps: Rinse lentils and check for stones. Finely dice onion, carrot and celery; mince garlic.
Heat olive oil in a deep pot and soften onion, carrot and celery for 7 minutes. Add garlic and rosemary; stir 1 minute, then add tomatoes and bay leaf.
Add lentils and 1,250 ml water. Simmer covered 25–30 minutes until lentils are nearly tender; season with salt.

Add pasta and remaining 350 ml water to the same pot. Simmer uncovered, stirring often, until pasta is just tender and the starchy broth is thick, about 10–12 minutes. Remove bay leaf and rest 5 minutes.
tips: The finished pasta should be thick and spoonable, not dry; loosen with hot water if it stands.

gu.Add pasta and remaining 350 ml water to: એ જ વાસણમાં પાસ્તા અને બાકી 350 મિ.લી. પાણી ઉમેરો. ઢાંકણ વિના વારંવાર હલાવી આશરે 10–12 મિનિટ પાસ્તા નરમ અને રસ ઘટ્ટ થાય ત્યાં સુધી પકાવો. તમાલપત્ર કાઢી 5 મિનિટ રાખો.

recipe.name: Pizzoccheri
steps: Peel potatoes and cut into 2 cm cubes; shred cabbage. Dice the vegetarian melting cheese and grate the hard cheese.
Bring measured salted water to a boil. Cook potatoes and cabbage 5 minutes; add pizzoccheri and simmer another 10–12 minutes until pasta and potatoes are tender.
Meanwhile heat butter gently with sliced garlic and sage until the butter turns nut-brown and garlic is golden; remove from heat before it burns.

Drain pasta and vegetables well. Layer them in a warm serving dish with both cheeses and pour the hot garlic-sage butter over each layer. Cover 2 minutes to melt the cheese, then fold gently and serve.
tips: Check the cheese label for vegetarian rennet; traditional cheeses may use animal rennet.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

hi.Check the cheese label for vegetarian re: चीज़ का लेबल जाँचें कि उसमें शाकाहारी रेनेट है; पारंपरिक चीज़ में पशु रेनेट हो सकता है।

gu.Check the cheese label for vegetarian re: ચીઝના લેબલમાં શાકાહારી રેનેટ છે તેની ખાતરી કરો; પરંપરાગત ચીઝમાં પ્રાણી રેનેટ હોઈ શકે.

recipe.name: Arroz con Verduras
steps: Warm the stock with saffron while you dice the vegetables into even pieces and rinse the rice briefly.
Soften onion in olive oil in a wide pan; add garlic, pepper, carrot and beans and cook until glossy but still firm.
Stir in grated tomato and paprika until the tomato thickens, then coat the rice in this vegetable base.
Pour in the hot stock, scatter over peas and simmer uncovered until the rice is tender and the liquid is absorbed; rest covered before serving.
tips: Use a wide pan and avoid stirring once the stock goes in so the rice cooks evenly.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Huggi
steps: Rinse the rice and moong dal together until the water runs clear, then drain them well.
Toast the moong dal gently in a heavy pot until fragrant without browning, and add the rice, water and salt.
Cook covered over a gentle heat, stirring occasionally, until the grains soften into a loose savory porridge.
Heat ghee separately; sizzle cumin, crushed pepper, ginger, cashews and curry leaves, then fold this tempering through the hot huggi.
tips: Keep it spoonable with a splash of hot water if it thickens while standing.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Thinai Pongal
steps: Rinse the foxtail millet and dry-roast the moong dal until it smells nutty but remains pale.
Cook millet and dal with water and salt in a covered pot until both are tender and the mixture is soft and creamy.
Crush the peppercorns lightly; heat ghee and fry cashews until golden, then add cumin, pepper, ginger, curry leaves and asafoetida.
Fold the fragrant tempering through the hot pongal and loosen with hot water if needed; serve immediately with chutney.
tips: Thinai absorbs moisture as it cools, so make the pongal slightly softer than you want to serve it.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Kashmiri Khetchir
steps: Rinse the rice and split moong thoroughly; soak them briefly, then drain so the grains cook evenly.
Heat mustard oil until its raw aroma fades, lower the heat and bloom cumin with a pinch of asafoetida.
Add rice, dal, ginger, fennel and turmeric; toss gently to coat without breaking the rice.
Pour in water and salt, cover and simmer gently until the dal is cooked and rice grains remain distinct; rest covered before fluffing.
tips: This Kashmiri-style khetchir is a simple vegetarian rice-and-moong dish; keep the grains distinct rather than mashing them.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Rasam Sadam
steps: Cook the toor dal until soft and mash it; dissolve tamarind in part of the water and squeeze out the pulp.
Simmer crushed tomato with tamarind water, turmeric, rasam powder and salt until the raw sour edge disappears.
Add mashed dal and remaining water; heat until a fine foam rises, then turn off the heat before a hard boil.
Sizzle mustard, cumin, crushed garlic and curry leaves in ghee; pour over the rasam, add coriander and mix generously with warm cooked rice.
tips: Add rice just before serving so it stays pleasantly soft rather than drinking up all the rasam.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

gu.Add mashed dal and remaining water; heat: મસળેલી દાળ અને બાકીનું પાણી ઉમેરો; ઉપર હળવો ફીણ આવે એટલે તાપ બંધ કરો, વધુ ઉકાળો નહીં.

recipe.name: Paruppu Sadam
steps: Rinse rice and toor dal separately, then cook the dal with turmeric until completely tender and easy to mash.
Cook the rice with its share of water until soft, keeping the grains moist rather than dry.
Mash the dal with salt and fold it into the warm rice, adding hot water as needed for a soft spoonable texture.
Heat ghee and crackle mustard, cumin, red chilli, asafoetida and curry leaves; pour the tempering over the rice-dal mixture.
tips: Serve warm with a little extra ghee and a dry vegetable side; the rice should stay moist.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Sweet Potato Congee
steps: Rinse rice well and peel the sweet potato; cut the potato into small even cubes so it softens with the rice.
Bring rice, sweet potato, sliced ginger and water to a boil, skimming away any foam.
Lower the heat and simmer partly covered, stirring frequently, until the grains break down and the sweet potato turns tender.
Season with salt, ladle into bowls and finish with spring onion greens and a few drops of toasted sesame oil.
tips: Add hot water while simmering if the porridge becomes thicker than you like.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Garlic Rasam
steps: Soak tamarind in warm water and squeeze it well; roughly crush the garlic, pepper and cumin.
Simmer chopped tomatoes in tamarind water with turmeric, rasam powder and salt until the tomatoes collapse.

Crackle mustard and curry leaves in ghee, pour over the rasam and finish with chopped coriander.

recipe.name: Pineapple Rasam
steps: Cook the toor dal until soft and mash it; crush half the pineapple and dice the rest for texture.
Simmer tomatoes, tamarind water, turmeric and rasam powder until the tomatoes soften and the raw sourness fades.
Add dal, pineapple and remaining water; warm until the pineapple is just tender and the broth begins to foam.
Sizzle mustard, cumin and curry leaves in ghee, pour over the rasam and scatter coriander just before serving.
tips: Use ripe fresh pineapple and keep the final simmer brief so its fruity aroma stays bright.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Paruppu Rasam
steps: Cook the toor dal with turmeric until very soft; mash it smooth and reserve its cooking liquid.
Boil chopped tomatoes with tamarind water, rasam powder and salt until the tomatoes lose their raw taste.
Stir in the dal and enough reserved liquid to make a light broth; heat only until a foamy layer rises.
Temper mustard, cumin, red chilli and curry leaves in ghee, pour over the rasam and finish with coriander.
tips: The dal gives this rasam body; dilute it enough to pour easily over rice.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Clear Vegetable Soup
steps: Slice the vegetables thinly and evenly so they cook quickly while keeping a little bite.
Warm oil in a pot, soften the spring onion whites and garlic, then add carrot, beans, celery and mushrooms.
Pour in stock and simmer gently until the firmer vegetables are just tender; add cabbage near the end.
Season with soy sauce, pepper and salt, then serve the clear broth with spring onion greens on top.
tips: Do not boil the soup vigorously or overcook the cabbage; a clear broth and crisp vegetables are the point.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Cream of Mushroom Soup
steps: Slice mushrooms and cook them in butter over medium heat until their moisture evaporates and the edges brown.
Add finely chopped onion, garlic and thyme; cook until soft, then stir in flour and cook away its raw taste.
Pour in stock gradually while whisking, simmer until the mushrooms are tender, then blend part of the soup for body.
Stir in milk and cream, warm gently without boiling and season with salt and black pepper.
tips: Reserve a few browned mushroom slices for the top so the soup still looks and tastes like mushrooms.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Broccoli Cheddar Soup
steps: Cut broccoli into small florets and dice the stalk; grate carrot and chop onion finely.
Soften onion in butter, stir in flour and cook briefly until the raw flour smell fades.
Whisk in stock and milk gradually; add broccoli and carrot and simmer until the vegetables are tender.
Reduce the heat, blend a small portion if desired, then stir in grated vegetarian cheddar until melted; season without boiling.
tips: Choose cheddar made with microbial or vegetarian rennet, and add it off the boil to keep the soup smooth.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Jeera Rasam
steps: Dry-roast cumin, pepper and coriander seeds lightly, cool them and crush them coarsely.
Extract tamarind into warm water and simmer it with crushed tomato, turmeric and salt until the raw edge fades.
Add the freshly crushed spice mixture and remaining water, then warm only until the rasam begins to foam.
Temper mustard and curry leaves in ghee, pour over the hot rasam and finish with coriander.
tips: Freshly roasted cumin should lead the aroma; do not substitute a heavy premixed masala.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Kollu Rasam
steps: Soak horse gram, then cook it with plenty of water until tender; reserve the earthy cooking broth and mash a little of the gram.
Crush pepper, cumin and garlic together and extract the tamarind in warm water.
Simmer tomato with tamarind, turmeric and salt until softened; add horse-gram broth, mashed gram and crushed spices.
Heat until the rasam foams, then finish with mustard, red chilli and curry leaves crackled in oil.
tips: Save the horse-gram cooking liquid: it gives this rasam its characteristic deep flavor.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Tomato Saar
steps: Blanch the tomatoes briefly, slip off their skins and puree the flesh until smooth.
Simmer the tomato puree with water, jaggery and salt until its raw flavor mellows into a light tangy broth.
Heat ghee separately and crackle mustard, cumin, slit green chilli and curry leaves without burning them.
Pour the fragrant tempering into the saar, simmer gently once more and garnish with chopped coriander.
tips: Balance sour tomatoes with just enough jaggery to round the flavor, not make the saar sweet.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Kokum Saar
steps: Soak the dried kokum in warm water until it colors the water deeply, then squeeze the rinds and strain the extract.
Warm the kokum extract with jaggery and salt over gentle heat until the jaggery dissolves; avoid a hard boil.
Heat ghee in a small pan and crackle cumin, broken dry chilli, asafoetida and curry leaves.
Pour the tempering into the warm kokum saar, stir once and serve with chopped coriander.
tips: Taste the kokum extract before sweetening because dried rinds vary greatly in tartness.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Kachumber Salad
steps: Wash and dry the cucumber and tomatoes, then dice them into small even pieces.
Finely dice onion and green chilli; chop the coriander leaves and combine them with the vegetables.
Whisk lemon juice with roasted cumin and salt until the salt dissolves.
Toss the dressing through the vegetables just before serving and drain any excess liquid from the bowl.
tips: Salt at the last moment so the cucumber stays crisp instead of releasing water.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

gu.Toss the dressing through the vegetables: પીરસતા પહેલાં જ મસાલેદાર રસ શાકમાં ભેળવો અને વાટકામાંનું વધારાનું પાણી કાઢી નાખો.

recipe.name: Greek Salad
steps: Cut tomatoes into wedges, cucumber into thick half-moons and pepper into strips; slice the onion thinly.
Soak sliced onion briefly in cold water, then drain and dry to soften its sharpness.
Arrange the vegetables and olives on a platter; place thick pieces of vegetarian feta on top.
Whisk olive oil, vinegar, oregano and salt, drizzle over everything and serve without crushing the feta.
tips: Use feta made with vegetarian rennet and ripe tomatoes; the salad needs no lettuce.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Eggless Caesar Salad
steps: Wash and completely dry the romaine, then chill the leaves so they stay crisp.
Toss bread cubes with some olive oil and minced garlic; toast until golden and let them cool.
Whisk eggless mayonnaise, lemon juice, mustard, grated vegetarian hard cheese, pepper and remaining oil into a creamy dressing.
Tear the lettuce, coat lightly with dressing and add croutons just before serving, finishing with more cheese.
tips: Check both mayonnaise and cheese labels: the dressing must contain no egg, anchovy or animal rennet.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

Drizzle olive oil and a little balsamic vinegar over the platter, then season with salt and pepper just before eating.

gu.Drizzle olive oil and a little balsamic: ઉપર ઓલિવ તેલ અને થોડું બાલ્સમિક વિનેગર રેડો; ખાતા પહેલાં મીઠું અને મરી ભભરાવો.

recipe.name: Gajar Koshimbir
steps: Peel and coarsely grate the carrots, then squeeze them gently only if they are very wet.
Whisk yogurt with salt and lemon juice; fold in carrot, coconut, finely chopped chilli and coriander.
Heat oil and pop the mustard seeds; add curry leaves and let the tempering cool slightly.
Pour the tempering over the koshimbir, toss once and chill briefly before serving.
tips: Keep the carrot raw and crisp; do not pour very hot oil directly onto the yogurt.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Kakdi Koshimbir
steps: Peel and finely dice cucumber, removing the watery seed core if it is very mature.
Whisk yogurt with sugar, salt and lemon; fold in cucumber, peanut powder, chilli and coriander.
Pop mustard seeds and curry leaves in hot oil, then let the tempering cool until merely warm.
Stir the cooled tempering into the koshimbir and serve promptly so the cucumber remains crisp.
tips: Roasted peanut powder thickens the dressing; add it shortly before serving.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Fattoush
steps: Tear pita into bite-sized pieces, brush with a little olive oil and bake or toast until crisp and golden.
Wash and dry lettuce and herbs; chop tomatoes, cucumber, radishes and spring onions into generous pieces.
Whisk remaining olive oil with lemon juice, pomegranate molasses, sumac and salt.
Toss vegetables and herbs with the tangy dressing, then fold in crisp pita immediately before serving.
tips: Add the pita at the table so it stays crunchy against the juicy vegetables.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Russian Salad
steps: Dice potatoes and carrots uniformly, then boil them separately until just tender; drain and cool completely.
Blanch beans and peas until bright and tender, cool them under running water and drain well.
Dice the apple, then whisk eggless mayonnaise with yogurt, lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Fold the cool vegetables and apple through the dressing without mashing; chill before serving.
tips: Dry and cool all cooked vegetables before dressing so the salad stays creamy rather than watery.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Coleslaw
steps: Shred both cabbages very finely and grate the carrot; dry the vegetables thoroughly.
Whisk eggless mayonnaise, yogurt, vinegar, sugar, mustard, salt and pepper until smooth.
Toss the vegetables with just enough dressing to coat every strand without pooling at the bottom.
Chill briefly for the flavors to mingle, then toss once more and serve while the cabbage still has crunch.
tips: If making ahead, keep dressing and shredded vegetables separate until near serving time.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

hi.Quantities serve four adults. Check the: मात्राएँ चार वयस्कों के लिए हैं। हर चरण में पकने के संकेत जाँचें और स्वाद के अनुसार मसाला बदलें। जैन उपयुक्तता आपके परिवार की सामग्री संबंधी नियमों पर निर्भर है।

recipe.name: Thai Green Papaya Salad
steps: Peel the green papaya and carrot, remove the papaya seeds and shred both into long thin strands.
Pound garlic and chilli gently with palm sugar, then stir in lime juice, soy sauce and tamarind until dissolved.
Lightly bruise the beans and tomatoes in a large bowl; add the shredded papaya and carrot.
Toss vigorously with the sweet-sour dressing until coated, then top with crushed roasted peanuts and serve at once.
tips: Use genuinely unripe papaya for crisp strands; soy sauce keeps the dressing vegetarian.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Chilli Paneer Roll
steps: Knead wheat flour with water and a little salt into a soft dough; rest it while you cut paneer and vegetables into strips.
Divide the dough, roll thin flatbreads and cook each on a hot skillet until lightly spotted and flexible.
Dust paneer lightly with cornflour and sear in oil until golden; remove, then stir-fry onion, pepper, ginger, garlic and chilli over high heat.
Return paneer to the pan with soy sauce and chilli sauce; toss until glossy and the sauce clings rather than runs.
Pile the warm chilli paneer onto flatbreads, fold in the ends and roll tightly; serve while the filling is hot.
tips: Keep the filling fairly dry so the roll stays easy to hold.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Paneer Frankie
steps: Knead flour with water and a little salt; rest the dough, then roll and cook flexible flatbreads on a hot skillet.
Marinate paneer strips in yogurt, chilli powder and garam masala while you slice onion and pepper.
Heat oil, soften half the onion with ginger-garlic paste, add tomato and cook until thick; toss in pepper and paneer until heated through.
Mix the remaining raw onion with lemon juice, chaat masala and coriander for a sharp crunchy topping.
Spoon paneer filling and seasoned onion down each flatbread, fold the sides and roll tightly in paper for serving.
tips: Let the tomato masala reduce fully before filling the frankie so the bread does not turn soggy.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Schezwan Frankie
steps: Knead the flour with water and a pinch of salt; rest, roll and cook soft flatbreads on a hot skillet.
Shred cabbage and carrot, slice pepper and separate spring onion whites from greens.
Stir-fry garlic and spring onion whites in hot oil; add the vegetables and cook quickly so they keep their crunch.
Toss in vegetarian Schezwan sauce and soy sauce until the vegetables are evenly coated; finish with spring onion greens and lemon.
Spread the warm filling across each flatbread, fold the ends and roll firmly; serve immediately.
tips: Check the Schezwan sauce label for vegetarian ingredients and keep the vegetables crisp.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Manchurian Roll
steps: Knead wheat flour and water with a little salt; rest, then roll and cook flexible flatbreads on a hot skillet.
Shred cabbage and carrot very finely and squeeze out moisture; combine with plain flour, half the cornflour and salt to make a firm mixture.
Shape small vegetable balls and fry in hot oil until golden and cooked through; drain them thoroughly.
Stir-fry garlic, ginger, spring onion whites and bell pepper in a little frying oil; add soy, chilli sauce and ketchup.
Slurry the remaining cornflour with a splash of water, add it to the pan and simmer until glossy; toss in the fried balls just before filling.
Scatter spring onion greens over the Manchurian, spoon it onto the warm flatbreads, fold the sides and roll firmly.
tips: Make a thick coating sauce rather than a watery gravy so the Manchurian stays inside the wrap.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Chowmein Roll
steps: Knead wheat flour with water and a little salt; rest and cook thin flexible flatbreads on a hot skillet.
Boil eggless noodles until just tender, drain and rinse briefly to stop cooking, then toss with a little oil.
Shred cabbage, carrot and pepper; stir-fry garlic and spring onion whites in a very hot wok, then add vegetables and keep them crisp.
Add noodles, soy sauce, vinegar, chilli sauce and pepper; toss over high heat until evenly coated and dry enough for wrapping.
Place a neat mound of hot chowmein on each flatbread, add spring onion greens, fold the ends and roll tightly.
tips: Use explicitly eggless noodles and avoid overcooking them, or the roll will turn soft and sticky.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Paneer Bhurji Roll
steps: Knead wheat flour with water and a little salt, then rest the dough and cook thin soft flatbreads.
Crumble the paneer by hand; finely dice onion, tomato and pepper so the filling spreads evenly.
Heat oil and crackle cumin; soften onion, ginger and green chilli, then cook tomato and turmeric until the mixture thickens.
Add pepper, crumbled paneer, garam masala and salt; toss just until the paneer is hot, then finish with coriander and lemon.
Spread warm bhurji along each flatbread, fold the sides and roll firmly; serve before the paneer dries out.
tips: Keep the paneer moist by adding it only after the tomato masala has reduced.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Mushroom Tikka Roll
steps: Quarter the mushrooms and coat with yogurt, toasted gram flour, ginger-garlic, chilli, garam masala, lemon juice and 4 g salt; marinate 15 minutes.
Knead flour with water, 10 ml oil and remaining salt into a soft dough. Rest 10 minutes, divide into four, and roll into thin rotis.
Cook the rotis on a hot tawa on both sides until brown spots form. In another pan, sear mushrooms in remaining oil over high heat for 7–9 minutes until browned and cooked through.
Spread 20 g mint chutney on each roti, add hot mushroom tikka and sliced onion, then roll tightly and serve immediately.
tips: Keep the pan hot and uncrowded so the mushrooms brown instead of steaming.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

hi.Quantities serve four adults. Check the: मात्राएँ चार वयस्कों के लिए हैं। हर चरण में पकने के संकेत जाँचें और स्वाद के अनुसार मसाला बदलें। जैन उपयुक्तता आपके परिवार की सामग्री संबंधी नियमों पर निर्भर है।
hi.Quarter the mushrooms and coat with yogu: मशरूम चार टुकड़ों में काटें और दही, भुना बेसन, अदरक-लहसुन, मिर्च, गरम मसाला, नींबू रस और 4 ग्राम नमक लगाकर 15 मिनट रखें।
hi.Knead flour with water, 10 ml oil and re: आटे में पानी, 10 मिली तेल और बचा नमक डालकर नरम गूँधें। 10 मिनट रखकर चार पतली रोटियाँ बेलें।
hi.Cook the rotis on a hot tawa on both sid: गरम तवे पर रोटियाँ दोनों ओर भूरे धब्बे आने तक सेंकें। दूसरे पैन में बचे तेल पर मशरूम तेज आँच पर 7–9 मिनट भूनें, ताकि वे पककर सुनहरे हों।
hi.Spread 20 g mint chutney on each roti, a: हर रोटी पर 20 ग्राम पुदीना चटनी लगाएँ, गरम मशरूम टिक्का और कटा प्याज़ रखें, कसकर रोल करें और तुरंत परोसें।
hi.Keep the pan hot and uncrowded so the mu: मशरूम भाप में गलने के बजाय सुनहरे हों, इसके लिए पैन गरम रखें और बहुत न भरें।

gu.Quantities serve four adults. Check the: માત્રા ચાર પુખ્ત વ્યક્તિઓ માટે છે. દરેક પગલામાં પાકવાના સંકેત તપાસો અને સ્વાદ પ્રમાણે મસાલો ગોઠવો. જૈન યોગ્યતા તમારા પરિવારના સામગ્રીના નિયમો પર આધારિત છે.
gu.Quarter the mushrooms and coat with yogu: મશરૂમના ચાર ટુકડા કરી દહીં, શેકેલો ચણાનો લોટ, આદુ-લસણ, મરચું, ગરમ મસાલો, લીંબુનો રસ અને 4 ગ્રામ મીઠું લગાવી 15 મિનિટ રાખો.
gu.Knead flour with water, 10 ml oil and re: લોટમાં પાણી, 10 મિલી તેલ અને બાકી મીઠું ઉમેરી નરમ બાંધો. 10 મિનિટ રાખી ચાર પાતળી રોટલી વણો.
gu.Cook the rotis on a hot tawa on both sid: ગરમ તવા પર રોટલી બંને બાજુ ભૂરાં ટપકાં પડે ત્યાં સુધી શેકો. બીજા પેનમાં બાકીના તેલમાં મશરૂમ તેજ તાપે 7–9 મિનિટ શેકો, જેથી તે પાકી જાય અને રંગ આવે.
gu.Spread 20 g mint chutney on each roti, a: દરેક રોટલી પર 20 ગ્રામ ફુદીનાની ચટણી લગાવો, ગરમ મશરૂમ ટિક્કા અને સમારેલી ડુંગળી મૂકો, ચુસ્ત વાળી તરત પીરસો.
gu.Keep the pan hot and uncrowded so the mu: મશરૂમ વરાળમાં બફાવાને બદલે શેકાય તે માટે પેન ગરમ રાખો અને વધારે ન ભરો.

recipe.name: Veg Seekh Kebab Roll
steps: Boil or steam peas and finely chopped beans until tender; drain completely. Mash them with potato, carrot, grated ginger and minced chilli.
Mix in roasted gram flour, cumin, garam masala and salt. Shape into eight firm logs around damp skewers or into free-standing cylinders.
Brush kebabs with oil and cook on a medium-hot pan for 10–12 minutes, turning carefully until browned on all sides and hot at the centre.
Warm the rotis, spread each with 20 g chutney, add two kebabs, sliced onion and lemon juice; fold the bottom and roll snugly.
tips: Drain cooked vegetables very well; excess moisture makes seekh kebabs break.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

hi.Quantities serve four adults. Check the: मात्राएँ चार वयस्कों के लिए हैं। हर चरण में पकने के संकेत जाँचें और स्वाद के अनुसार मसाला बदलें। जैन उपयुक्तता आपके परिवार की सामग्री संबंधी नियमों पर निर्भर है।
hi.Boil or steam peas and finely chopped be: मटर और बारीक कटी फलियाँ नरम होने तक पकाकर अच्छी तरह छानें। आलू, गाजर, कसा अदरक और कटी मिर्च के साथ मैश करें।
hi.Mix in roasted gram flour, cumin, garam: भुना बेसन, जीरा, गरम मसाला और नमक मिलाएँ। मिश्रण को गीली सीकों पर या बिना सींक के आठ मज़बूत लंबे कबाब बनाएँ।
hi.Brush kebabs with oil and cook on a medi: कबाब पर तेल लगाकर मध्यम-गरम पैन में 10–12 मिनट सावधानी से पलटते हुए चारों ओर सुनहरा और बीच तक गरम होने दें।
hi.Warm the rotis, spread each with 20 g ch: रोटियाँ गरम करें। हर रोटी पर 20 ग्राम चटनी, दो कबाब, कटा प्याज़ और नींबू रस डालें; नीचे से मोड़कर कसकर रोल करें।
hi.Drain cooked vegetables very well; exces: पकी सब्ज़ियाँ अच्छी तरह छानें; अधिक नमी से सीख कबाब टूटते हैं।

gu.Quantities serve four adults. Check the: માત્રા ચાર પુખ્ત વ્યક્તિઓ માટે છે. દરેક પગલામાં પાકવાના સંકેત તપાસો અને સ્વાદ પ્રમાણે મસાલો ગોઠવો. જૈન યોગ્યતા તમારા પરિવારના સામગ્રીના નિયમો પર આધારિત છે.
gu.Boil or steam peas and finely chopped be: વટાણા અને ઝીણી સમારેલી ફણસી નરમ થાય ત્યાં સુધી બાફી સારી રીતે નિતારી લો. બટાકા, ગાજર, છીણેલું આદુ અને સમારેલાં મરચાં સાથે મસળો.
gu.Mix in roasted gram flour, cumin, garam: શેકેલો ચણાનો લોટ, જીરું, ગરમ મસાલો અને મીઠું મિક્સ કરો. ભીની સળીઓ પર અથવા સળી વગર આઠ મજબૂત લાંબા કબાબ આકારો.
gu.Brush kebabs with oil and cook on a medi: કબાબ પર તેલ લગાવી મધ્યમ-ગરમ પેનમાં 10–12 મિનિટ કાળજીથી ફેરવતાં બધી બાજુ ભૂરા અને અંદર સુધી ગરમ કરો.
gu.Warm the rotis, spread each with 20 g ch: રોટલીઓ ગરમ કરો. દરેક પર 20 ગ્રામ ચટણી, બે કબાબ, સમારેલી ડુંગળી અને લીંબુનો રસ નાખો; નીચેથી વાળી ચુસ્ત રોલ કરો.
gu.Drain cooked vegetables very well; exces: બાફેલા શાક ખૂબ સારી રીતે નિતારો; વધારે ભેજથી સીખ કબાબ તૂટી જાય છે.

recipe.name: Rumali Roti Roll
steps: Knead both flours with yogurt, water and 2 g salt until soft and elastic. Cover for 20 minutes, then divide into four balls.
Roll each ball as thin and wide as possible. Cook briefly on a very hot wide tawa, flipping when small bubbles appear; keep the pliable rumali rotis covered in a clean cloth.

Heat oil; stir-fry sliced onion and pepper for 3 minutes. Add ginger-garlic, chilli, garam masala, remaining salt and paneer strips; toss 4–5 minutes until paneer is hot and the vegetables retain a little bite.
Spread each soft roti with 20 g chutney; divide the hot paneer filling among them, sprinkle lemon juice and fold into four rolls.
tips: Cook rumali roti only until set; overcooking makes this very thin bread brittle.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

hi.Quantities serve four adults. Check the: मात्राएँ चार वयस्कों के लिए हैं। हर चरण में पकने के संकेत जाँचें और स्वाद के अनुसार मसाला बदलें। जैन उपयुक्तता आपके परिवार की सामग्री संबंधी नियमों पर निर्भर है।
hi.Knead both flours with yogurt, water and: दोनों आटे, दही, पानी और 2 ग्राम नमक मिलाकर नरम लचीला आटा गूँधें। 20 मिनट ढककर रखें, फिर चार गोले बनाएँ।
hi.Roll each ball as thin and wide as possi: हर गोला जितना हो सके उतना पतला और चौड़ा बेलें। बहुत गरम बड़े तवे पर छोटे बुलबुले आते ही पलटकर थोड़ी देर पकाएँ; नरम रुमाली रोटियाँ साफ कपड़े में ढककर रखें।
hi.Heat oil; stir-fry sliced onion and pepp: तेल गरम करके कटा प्याज़ और शिमला मिर्च 3 मिनट भूनें। अदरक-लहसुन, मिर्च, गरम मसाला, बचा नमक और पनीर की पट्टियाँ डालें; 4–5 मिनट चलाएँ, जब तक पनीर गरम और सब्ज़ियाँ हल्की कुरकुरी हों।
hi.Spread each soft roti with 20 g chutney;: हर नरम रोटी पर 20 ग्राम चटनी लगाएँ; गरम पनीर की भरावन चारों में बाँटें, नींबू रस छिड़कें और रोल करें।
hi.Cook rumali roti only until set; overcoo: रुमाली रोटी केवल पकने तक ही सेंकें; अधिक सेंकने पर पतली रोटी टूटने लगती है।

gu.Quantities serve four adults. Check the: માત્રા ચાર પુખ્ત વ્યક્તિઓ માટે છે. દરેક પગલામાં પાકવાના સંકેત તપાસો અને સ્વાદ પ્રમાણે મસાલો ગોઠવો. જૈન યોગ્યતા તમારા પરિવારના સામગ્રીના નિયમો પર આધારિત છે.
gu.Knead both flours with yogurt, water and: બંને લોટ, દહીં, પાણી અને 2 ગ્રામ મીઠું ભેળવી નરમ લવચીક લોટ બાંધો. 20 મિનિટ ઢાંકીને રાખી ચાર ગોળા બનાવો.
gu.Roll each ball as thin and wide as possi: દરેક ગોળો શક્ય હોય તેટલો પાતળો અને પહોળો વણો. ખૂબ ગરમ મોટા તવા પર નાના પરપોટા દેખાય ત્યારે પલટાવી થોડું શેકો; નરમ રૂમાલી રોટલી ચોખ્ખા કપડામાં ઢાંકી રાખો.
gu.Heat oil; stir-fry sliced onion and pepp: તેલ ગરમ કરી સમારેલી ડુંગળી અને કેપ્સિકમ 3 મિનિટ સાંતળો. આદુ-લસણ, મરચું, ગરમ મસાલો, બાકી મીઠું અને પનીરની પટ્ટીઓ નાખો; પનીર ગરમ અને શાક થોડું કરકરું રહે ત્યાં સુધી 4–5 મિનિટ હલાવો.
gu.Spread each soft roti with 20 g chutney;: દરેક નરમ રોટલી પર 20 ગ્રામ ચટણી લગાવો; ગરમ પનીરનું પુરણ ચારેયમાં વહેંચો, લીંબુનો રસ છાંટી રોલ કરો.
gu.Cook rumali roti only until set; overcoo: રૂમાલી રોટલી માત્ર પાકે ત્યાં સુધી જ શેકો; વધારે શેકવાથી આ પાતળી રોટલી ભાંગી જાય છે.

recipe.name: Aloo Tikki Wrap
steps: Mash the potato with cooked, well-drained peas, cornflour, grated ginger, minced chilli, cumin, chaat masala and salt. Shape into eight flat, even tikkis.
Heat oil in a pan and shallow-fry tikkis 4–5 minutes per side over medium heat until both sides are deep golden and crisp; drain briefly.
Warm rotis and spread each with 20 g green chutney and 20 g yogurt. Arrange two tikkis and sliced cucumber on each.
Fold in the sides, roll firmly and toast the seam side for 1 minute so the wrap holds together; serve while crisp.
tips: Use dry, cooled potatoes; wet mash prevents the tikki crust from crisping.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

hi.Quantities serve four adults. Check the: मात्राएँ चार वयस्कों के लिए हैं। हर चरण में पकने के संकेत जाँचें और स्वाद के अनुसार मसाला बदलें। जैन उपयुक्तता आपके परिवार की सामग्री संबंधी नियमों पर निर्भर है।
hi.Mash the potato with cooked, well-draine: आलू को पके और अच्छी तरह छाने मटर, कॉर्नफ्लोर, कसे अदरक, कटी मिर्च, जीरा, चाट मसाला और नमक के साथ मैश करें। आठ चपटी समान टिक्कियाँ बनाएँ।
hi.Heat oil in a pan and shallow-fry tikkis: पैन में तेल गरम करके टिक्कियाँ मध्यम आँच पर हर ओर 4–5 मिनट गहरी सुनहरी और कुरकुरी होने तक सेंकें; थोड़ा तेल टपकने दें।
hi.Warm rotis and spread each with 20 g gre: रोटियाँ गरम करके हर एक पर 20 ग्राम हरी चटनी और 20 ग्राम दही लगाएँ। हर रोटी पर दो टिक्कियाँ और कटा खीरा रखें।
hi.Fold in the sides, roll firmly and toast: किनारे अंदर मोड़कर कसकर रोल करें और जोड़ वाली तरफ 1 मिनट सेंकें ताकि रैप बंद रहे; कुरकुरा रहते परोसें।
hi.Use dry, cooled potatoes; wet mash preve: सूखे, ठंडे आलू लें; गीले मिश्रण पर कुरकुरी परत नहीं बनती।

gu.Quantities serve four adults. Check the: માત્રા ચાર પુખ્ત વ્યક્તિઓ માટે છે. દરેક પગલામાં પાકવાના સંકેત તપાસો અને સ્વાદ પ્રમાણે મસાલો ગોઠવો. જૈન યોગ્યતા તમારા પરિવારના સામગ્રીના નિયમો પર આધારિત છે.
gu.Mash the potato with cooked, well-draine: બટાકાને બાફેલા સારી રીતે નિતારેલા વટાણા, કોર્નફ્લોર, છીણેલું આદુ, સમારેલાં મરચાં, જીરું, ચાટ મસાલો અને મીઠા સાથે મસળો. આઠ સરખી ચપટી ટિક્કી બનાવો.

recipe.name: Eggless Black Forest Cake
steps: Heat the oven to 170°C and line a 15 cm round tin. Sift flour, cocoa, baking powder and baking soda together.
Whisk sugar, yogurt, milk, oil and vanilla until smooth. Fold in the dry mix just until no flour remains; pour into the tin.
Bake for 30–35 minutes until a skewer comes out clean. Cool completely, then cut the sponge into two even layers.
Whip cold cream with icing sugar to firm peaks. Brush the cut sponge with cherry syrup, spread cream and chopped cherries between the layers, then cover the top and sides with cream.
Shave dark chocolate over the cake, add remaining cherries and chill at least 30 minutes before slicing.
tips: Whip cream straight from the refrigerator so the frosting stays stable.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Eggless Pineapple Cake
steps: Heat oven to 170°C and line a 15 cm round cake tin. Sift flour, baking powder and baking soda.
Whisk sugar, yogurt, milk, oil and vanilla. Fold in the sifted ingredients gently, pour into the tin and bake for 30–35 minutes until a skewer comes out clean.
Cool the sponge completely and split it horizontally. Whip chilled cream with icing sugar to firm peaks; chop most pineapple pieces and save a few for the top.
Moisten both cut layers with pineapple juice. Fill with cream and chopped pineapple, cover the cake with remaining cream, decorate with saved fruit and refrigerate 30 minutes before serving.
tips: Drain pineapple thoroughly; wet fruit makes the cream slide off the sponge.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Nankhatai
steps: Heat oven to 165°C and line a baking tray. Sift flour, gram flour, semolina, baking powder, cardamom and salt together.
Beat softened ghee with powdered sugar until pale and fluffy. Fold in the dry mixture just until it forms a soft dough; do not knead.
Shape 12 small balls, flatten gently and space them apart on the tray. Press a little chopped pistachio onto each top.
Bake 16–20 minutes until the edges are lightly golden, while the centres still look pale. Rest on the tray for 10 minutes before moving to a rack to cool fully.
tips: Nankhatai firms up as it cools; moving it hot can make it crumble.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Eggless Red Velvet Cake
steps: Heat oven to 170°C and line a 15 cm round tin. Stir vinegar into milk and leave 5 minutes to make a quick buttermilk.
Sift flour, cocoa, baking powder and baking soda. Whisk sugar, oil, buttermilk, red gel and vanilla; fold in the dry ingredients without overmixing.
Pour into the tin and bake 30–35 minutes until a skewer comes out clean. Cool completely and split the cake horizontally.
Beat softened butter and icing sugar until light, then beat in cool cream cheese only until smooth. Spread frosting between the layers and over the cake; chill 30 minutes before cutting.
tips: Use food-safe red gel colour; liquid colouring can thin the batter.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Eggless Butterscotch Cake
steps: Heat oven to 170°C and line a 15 cm tin. Sift flour, baking powder and baking soda; whisk sponge sugar, yogurt, milk, oil and vanilla separately.
Fold dry ingredients into wet, pour into the tin and bake 30–35 minutes until a skewer is clean. Cool fully and cut into two layers.
Melt caramel sugar in a heavy pan over medium heat until amber. Take off heat, carefully stir in butter and warm sauce cream, then salt; cool. Chop toasted cashews.
Whip cold cream with icing sugar to firm peaks. Spread cream, a little sauce and cashews between sponge layers; coat the cake, drizzle with remaining sauce and scatter the remaining nuts.
Refrigerate the decorated cake for 30 minutes so the layers set before slicing.
tips: Warm cream before adding it to caramel; cold cream makes the hot sugar seize and splatter.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Eggless Mawa Cake
steps: Heat oven to 170°C and line a 15 cm cake tin. Crumble mawa finely so no large lumps remain; sift flour with baking powder and salt.
Beat softened butter and sugar until pale. Beat in mawa and cardamom, then fold in the flour mixture alternately with milk to make a thick, spoonable batter.
Spoon the batter into the tin, level gently and scatter chopped pistachios on top. Bake 35–40 minutes until deep golden and a skewer comes out clean.
Rest the cake in its tin for 15 minutes, then unmould and cool on a rack before slicing into four generous portions.
tips: Use fresh mawa and keep the cake refrigerated after cooling because it is dairy-rich.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Eggless Plum Cake
steps: Warm orange juice gently, pour over dried fruit and soak at least 30 minutes. Heat oven to 160°C and line a 15 cm deep cake tin.
Sift flour, baking powder, baking soda, cinnamon and ginger. Whisk brown sugar, yogurt, oil, milk and vanilla until smooth.
Fold dry mix into wet, then stir in the soaked fruit with any remaining juice and the walnuts. Spoon the thick batter into the tin.
Bake 50–60 minutes, covering loosely with foil if the top browns early, until a skewer inserted in the centre comes out without wet batter.
Cool in the tin for 20 minutes, then on a rack until fully cold; slice only after the crumb settles.
tips: Use unsweetened dried fruit if possible; the brown sugar already supplies enough sweetness.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Eggless Chocolate Chip Cookies
steps: Cream softened butter with both sugars until smooth and slightly fluffy; mix in milk and vanilla.
Sift flour, baking soda and salt over the bowl. Fold just until combined, then mix in most chocolate chips. Chill the dough 20 minutes.
Heat oven to 180°C and line a tray. Divide dough into 12 balls, space them well apart and press the remaining chips on top.
Bake 10–12 minutes until edges are set and golden but centres are still slightly soft. Leave on the hot tray for 5 minutes, then transfer to a rack.
tips: Do not overbake; the cookies continue to firm up on the hot tray.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Eggless Chocolate Truffle Cake
steps: Heat oven to 170°C and line a 15 cm round tin. Sift flour, cocoa, baking powder and soda; whisk sugar, yogurt, sponge milk, oil and vanilla separately.
Fold dry mix into wet, pour into the tin and bake 30–35 minutes until a skewer comes out clean. Cool completely, then split into two layers.
Chop chocolate finely. Heat ganache cream until steaming, pour over chocolate, rest 2 minutes and stir from the centre to a glossy smooth ganache; cool until spreadable.
Brush both cake layers with soaking milk. Spread one third of ganache between them, coat top and sides with the rest, then refrigerate for at least 30 minutes before serving.
tips: Let the ganache thicken at room temperature before spreading, so it does not run off the cake.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
