recipe.name: Eggless Marble Cake
steps: Heat oven to 170°C and line a 15 cm loaf tin. Sift flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt together.
Whisk sugar, yogurt, 120 ml milk, oil and vanilla; fold in sifted ingredients. Transfer one third of batter to another bowl and stir in cocoa with 20 ml extra milk.
Spoon alternating dollops of vanilla and cocoa batters into the tin. Draw a skewer through the batter in two gentle figure-eight motions to create a marble pattern.
Bake 35–40 minutes until a skewer inserted into the centre comes out clean. Cool 15 minutes in the tin, then fully on a rack before slicing.
tips: Swirl only briefly; too much mixing blurs the dark and light pattern.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Mango Smoothie
steps: Peel the mango, cut the flesh from the stone and chill or freeze the cubes for 10 minutes.
Put mango, yogurt and milk into a blender; blend until completely smooth with no fibres or lumps.
Add honey and cardamom, taste for sweetness and blend briefly with the ice until thick and frothy.
Pour into four cold glasses and serve immediately, before the ice melts and thins the smoothie.
tips: Very sweet mangoes may need little or no honey; taste before adding it all.

recipe.name: Blueberry Oat Smoothie
steps: Soak oats in 180 ml milk for 10 minutes until softened; rinse fresh blueberries and check them for stems.
Blend soaked oats and their milk with yogurt and sliced banana until the oats are finely broken down.
Add blueberries, remaining 180 ml milk, honey and cinnamon; blend until smooth and thick, scraping down the blender once.
Divide into four glasses and serve at once before the oats continue to thicken the drink.

recipe.name: Peanut Butter Oat Smoothie
steps: Soak oats and chopped dates in 220 ml milk for 10 minutes to soften both; peel and slice bananas.
Blend the soaked oats, dates and their milk until the oats are very fine and no date chunks remain.
Add banana, peanut butter, cinnamon and remaining 200 ml milk; blend until creamy, then pulse briefly with the ice.
Pour into four glasses and serve straight away; stir if the oats settle as the smoothie stands.
tips: Use unsweetened peanut butter so the dates control the sweetness; this drink contains peanuts.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Green Smoothie
steps: Wash spinach and mint thoroughly. Peel the kiwi and banana; core the apple and chop it with the cucumber.
Blend spinach, mint and half the water first until the leaves are finely puréed.
Add banana, kiwi, apple, cucumber, lemon juice and remaining water; blend until evenly green and smooth.
Taste for tartness, divide into four glasses and drink immediately while the colour and freshness are at their best.
tips: Use tender baby spinach rather than mature fibrous leaves for a smoother drink.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Acai Bowl
steps: Break the frozen açaí pulp into chunks and let it soften for 2–3 minutes only; slice the fresh strawberries for topping.
Blend açaí, frozen banana and frozen berries with half the milk, stopping to scrape the blender; add the rest only if the blades cannot turn.
Keep the mixture thick enough to hold a spoon. Spoon it into four cold bowls rather than pouring it into glasses.
Top each bowl with granola, sliced strawberries and pumpkin seeds; serve immediately before the frozen base melts.
tips: Use unsweetened açaí pulp, not bottled açaí juice, to get the thick bowl texture.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Tropical Smoothie
steps: Remove the hard pineapple core, cube the pineapple and mango, and slice the peeled banana; chill the fruit well.
Blend pineapple and mango with half the coconut milk until the fibrous pineapple is fully puréed.
Add banana, remaining coconut milk and lime juice; blend until silky, then pulse with ice for a frothy finish.
Pour into four chilled glasses and serve immediately while thick and cold.
tips: Use full-fat coconut milk for a creamy texture; shake the can before measuring.

recipe.name: Virgin Mojito
steps: Wash mint gently, pat dry and remove tough stems. Cut limes into wedges and squeeze enough fresh juice.
Divide mint, lime wedges and syrup among four glasses; press each only a few times to release the oils without shredding the mint.
Add 30 ml lime juice and 100 g ice to each glass. Pour 150 ml chilled club soda into each, then stir once from the bottom.
Serve immediately while the drink is fizzy, with the mint and lime visible in the glasses.
tips: Avoid crushing mint too hard; bruised stems make a mojito bitter.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Virgin Pina Colada
steps: Remove the tough pineapple core, chill the fruit and reserve four wedges for garnish.
Blend pineapple chunks with pineapple juice until the fruit is completely smooth; strain only if a very fine texture is wanted.
Add coconut cream, lime juice and ice; blend until thick, creamy and slushy with no large ice pieces.
Divide among four chilled glasses, garnish each with a pineapple wedge and serve at once.
tips: Use coconut cream rather than thin coconut water for the classic creamy body.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Blue Lagoon Mocktail
steps: Check that the blue curaçao syrup is labelled alcohol-free; chill the lemonade and cut four thin lemon slices.
In a jug, stir syrup and fresh lemon juice together until evenly blue and tart.
Divide ice among four glasses and pour the syrup mixture over it. Top each glass slowly with chilled lemonade to keep its bubbles.
Stir once, garnish with a lemon slice and serve immediately while sparkling.
tips: Choose alcohol-free blue syrup, not alcoholic blue curaçao liqueur.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Virgin Margarita
steps: Squeeze fresh lime and orange juice and strain out seeds. Spread salt on a small plate.
Rub each glass rim with a lime wedge and dip lightly in salt; fill the four glasses with ice.
Shake lime juice, orange juice and agave syrup with a little ice until well chilled. Strain equally into the prepared glasses.
Top each with sparkling water, stir gently and serve with a lime wedge while cold and fizzy.
tips: Start with a light salt rim; guests can choose how much salt to sip with the drink.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Virgin Strawberry Daiquiri
steps: Rinse and hull strawberries, then freeze the main portion for 20 minutes for a thicker frozen-style daiquiri.
Blend chilled strawberries with fresh lime juice, sugar syrup and water until the fruit is completely smooth.
Add crushed ice and blend only until slushy and pourable; taste and adjust with a little of the measured syrup if the berries are tart.
Pour into four chilled glasses, garnish with saved strawberries and serve at once before the ice melts.
tips: Keep this mocktail alcohol-free; the strawberry-lime balance carries the flavour.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Virgin Sangria
steps: Wash fruit well. Thinly slice orange and lemon, core and dice apple, and put them in a large jug with the cinnamon stick.
Pour in grape, pomegranate and orange juices; stir gently to coat the fruit without crushing it.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes so the fruit and cinnamon infuse the juices. Remove the cinnamon if its flavour becomes strong.
Divide ice and some infused fruit among four glasses, pour over the juice mixture, top with sparkling water and serve at once.
tips: Use 100% fruit juices without alcohol; add the fizzy water only when serving.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Shirley Temple
steps: Chill the ginger ale and four serving glasses. Check that grenadine is a non-alcoholic pomegranate syrup.
Put 100 g ice into each glass and pour 25 ml grenadine and about 12 ml lime juice over the ice.
Slowly top each glass with about 195 ml chilled ginger ale so the red syrup makes a gentle gradient.
Add cocktail cherries, give each drink one gentle stir and serve immediately while sparkling.
tips: Use plain non-alcoholic grenadine; some cocktail cherry jars contain alcohol, so check the label too.

recipe.name: Watermelon Mojito
steps: Remove any seeds from watermelon, cube the flesh and blend it until smooth; strain only if a pulp-free drink is wanted.
Divide mint and lime wedges among four glasses. Press gently a few times to release their aroma without tearing the leaves.
Add watermelon purée, lime juice and syrup to the glasses, then 100 g ice in each; stir from the bottom.
Top each with 120 ml chilled club soda and serve immediately while the fizz and fresh watermelon flavour last.
tips: Ripe watermelon is usually sweet enough; taste it before using all the syrup.

recipe.name: Strawberry Mojito
steps: Rinse and hull strawberries, then finely chop half and lightly mash the rest to make a fresh fruit base.
Put mint and lime wedges into four glasses and press very gently. Divide both chopped and mashed strawberries among them.
Add lime juice and syrup, stir to mix with the fruit, and fill each glass with 100 g ice.
Pour 150 ml chilled club soda into each glass, stir once and serve immediately with visible strawberry pieces.
tips: Light muddling preserves mint’s fresh flavour; crushing it hard makes the drink bitter.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Kala Khatta Mojito
steps: Check that kala khatta syrup is non-alcoholic and taste it for sweetness; rinse and dry the mint leaves.
Divide mint and lime wedges among four glasses and press gently a few times. Add 30 ml syrup and 25 ml fresh lime juice to each.
Mix black salt and roasted cumin into the liquid, then put 100 g ice in each glass.

tips: Kala khatta syrup varies in sweetness; start with the measured amount and adjust only after tasting.
